## INCIDENT REPORT

**Incident Date:** 2026-02-28  
**Evidence Source:** 2026-02-28-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap

### VICTIM HOST IDENTIFICATION

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| IPv4 Address | 10.2.28.88 |
| MAC Address | 00:19:d1:b2:4d:ad |
| Windows Hostname | DESKTOP-TEYQ2NR |
| Domain | EASYAS123 |
| Logged-in User Account | Unable to extract from traffic |
| Operating System | Windows 10 (based on user-agent analysis) |

### MALWARE FAMILY

**Family Name:** NetSupport RAT (Remote Access Trojan)  
**Version:** NetSupport Manager/1.3 and NetSupport Gateway/1.92  
**Attribution:** Signature-confirmed (HTTP response explicitly identifies "Server: NetSupport Gateway/1.92 (Windows NT)" and user-agent contains "NetSupport Manager/1.3")

**Behavioral Evidence:**
- Continuous HTTP requests to C&C server using NetSupport protocol
- Encrypted command responses in format: CMD=ENCD, ES=1, DATA=[encrypted payload]
- This indicates active command execution and control channel

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

#### Command & Control Endpoints

**Primary C&C Server:**
- IP Address: 45.131.214.85:80
- Domain: vadusa.xyz (resolves to 45.131.214.85)
- Malicious URL: http://45.131.214.85/fakeurl.htm
- Protocol: HTTP with NetSupport Gateway RAT protocol
- Activity: 550 packets exchanged, 2 confirmed 200 OK responses with encrypted payloads

**Secondary C&C Server:**
- IP Address: 23.218.232.156:443
- Domain: deff.nelreports.net (also resolves to 23.218.232.141)
- Protocol: HTTPS

#### Additional Suspicious IPs (Potential Proxy/Relay Infrastructure)

- 150.171.28.11:443 (spoofed SNI: edge.microsoft.com)
- 150.171.27.11:443 (spoofed SNI: edge.microsoft.com)

#### Malicious Domains

- **vadusa.xyz** (resolves to 45.131.214.85)
- **deff.nelreports.net** (resolves to 23.218.232.156, 23.218.232.141)

#### File Names/Hashes

No directly extracted executable hashes from packet payloads. The C&C responses contain encrypted data fields that prevent hash extraction from the captured traffic.

#### Summary Traffic Pattern

- Total packets from victim: 7,405 TCP packets to external destinations
- Repeated beaconing to 45.131.214.85 (~274 distinct request-response cycles)
- Encrypted C&C communications with CMD=ENCD protocol indicates active compromise
- SMB enumeration traffic to domain controller (10.2.28.2) suggests lateral movement preparation

---

**Report Status:** Complete analysis based on packet capture evidence. Host is actively compromised with NetSupport RAT under active command and control.
